summary: The run-tests.yml workflow sets matrix.runs_on_override to 'ubuntu-latest-8-cores', a custom runner that doesn't exist in most forks, causing workflow jobs to queue for 24 hours and timeout automatically. Forks need a guard condition to skip this matrix configuration or use the standard runner.
userImpact: Developers who fork the repository experience workflow failures and 24-hour timeouts when attempting to run tests, making it difficult to validate changes locally.
rootCause: The workflow matrix specifies 'ubuntu-latest-8-cores' as a custom GitHub Actions runner that only exists in the temporalio organization, not in contributor forks, causing jobs to wait indefinitely for an unavailable runner.
proposedFix: Add an 'if: github.repository_owner == "temporalio"' condition to skip the custom runner matrix for non-temporalio forks, or use a 'vars.HAS_UBUNTU_LATEST_8_CORES' guard to conditionally enable the custom runner configuration.
resolutionDetails: Workflow updated to include proper guard conditions preventing forks from attempting to use unavailable custom runners.
keyQuote: Job queue time 24 hours - A job can be in the queue for 24 hours before it is automatically cancelled.
